name: Facebook Community Sales OS - Social AIO Runtime
notes: Adds sheet-native Group API controls in QUÉT NHÓM without changing columns A:P business data.
Columns W:Z are operator controls: Chọn API, API Quét/Dừng, API trạng thái, API chi tiết; derived Q:V counters are preserved and hidden in the operator view.

Opening Social AIO Control Center automatically prepares the controls and installs an authorized onEdit trigger using the existing importJsonFiles bootstrap wrapper, so Code.gs does not need to be replaced.
Per-row command supports QUÉT and DỪNG. Stop takes effect after the current Social AIO API call/page returns.
The modeless Control Center polls selected groups and provides scan-selected / stop-selected / clear-selection actions.
Batch scanning uses a 230-second execution budget and leaves deferred groups selected for the next run.
Comment POC now rejects a Group root URL early with a clear message instead of surfacing Cannot get post ID from URL.
Bridge remains first-page POC; pagination/scheduler stay gated on API schema and latency acceptance.
